summary: FromSoftware's early HD-era turn-based RPG, originally for Xbox 360 and later PlayStation 3.

entries.title: Enchanted Arms

emulation.emulator: None for primary; RPCS3 as PS3 fallback
emulation.notes: Prefer official Xbox backward compatibility. Use RPCS3 only if Xbox access is unavailable.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Xbox backward-compatible output on modern Xbox hardware.

primary.why: Enchanted Arms released on Xbox 360 and PS3, and the Xbox 360 version is officially backward compatible on modern Xbox hardware; that is the cleanest current capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Xbox 360 disc or existing digital license on Xbox One or Xbox Series X/S where backward compatibility is available. PS3 hardware/RPCS3 is the fallback route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remake/remaster exists; digital availability can vary, so owned disc/license matters.
